name: uci_cleveland_heart_disease
description: Academic benchmark: classify the presence or absence of angiographic heart disease from 13 clinical attributes in the UCI Cleveland Heart Disease dataset. This is retrospective historical data and is not a clinical diagnostic system.

inputs.sex: Sex code as recorded in the UCI dataset (categorical code).
inputs.cp: Chest-pain type code as recorded in the UCI dataset (categorical code).
inputs.trestbps: Resting blood pressure in mm Hg.
inputs.fbs: Fasting blood sugar indicator as recorded in the UCI dataset (categorical code).
inputs.oldpeak: ST depression induced by exercise relative to rest.
inputs.slope: Slope of the peak exercise ST segment (categorical code).
inputs.ca: Number of major vessels colored by fluoroscopy (0–3; may be missing in source).
inputs.thal: Thallium stress-test result code (categorical code; may be missing in source).

rubric: ACADEMIC PROXY ONLY: for this software experiment, a false negative is assigned weight 2 and a false positive weight 1 to illustrate asymmetric error costs. These weights are not clinically validated severity estimates and must not be used for patient care or medical decisions.
